product.title: Boeing Factory Tour with Guided Transport from Seattle

description.text: Travel from downtown Seattle to the Boeing Future of Flight facility for a guided factory tour of the world's largest building by volume. Explore assembly-line viewing areas and aviation exhibits with round-trip transport from the Hyatt Regency Seattle.

highlights: Visit Future of Flight Aviation Center exhibits
See 777 and 787 production lines from viewing balconies

start.description: Pickup at Hyatt Regency Seattle, 808 Howell Street, Seattle, WA 98101.

end.description: Return to the Hyatt Regency Seattle pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Travel from downtown Seattle to the Boeing Future of Flight facility for a guided factory tour of the world's largest building by volume.

itineraryItems.title: Hyatt Regency pickup
itineraryItems.description: Meet at the downtown Seattle hotel before the drive north to Everett.

itineraryItems.title: Future of Flight Center
itineraryItems.description: Explore aviation exhibits and gallery displays before the factory tour begins.

itineraryItems.title: Boeing factory tour
itineraryItems.description: Tour the assembly plant viewing areas to see commercial aircraft production lines.

itineraryItems.title: Return to Seattle
itineraryItems.description: Drive back to downtown Seattle after the factory and gallery visit.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
